items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I don't ever remember playing inside, even when Lou Rose had the Winter Garden. I used to put the fights on there.

ctx.x: of that park in Metry? Uh, it begins with an E, I think. It's no longer there. Oh, is that Lecter Park? No, it's another one. Right over there, uh, Eastman? Eastman. Yeah. You played there? Oh, yes. We played all that. Sometime or rather we played all around. Did you all ever play any of the pretendy dances at Tulane?

That I don't remember of ever playing up there. What about prize fights? Well, yes. We played on the wagon for prize fights. You never played in the fight? In the inside? No, there wasn't any reason to have a band in there at that time. Oh, yeah. I've heard Shillings, any number of times. Well, that must have been later on. I mean, because, uh... Oh, it was later on. I would say it was maybe around 1920, around that... Oh, yeah. That was later. I remember that, uh, later on they played in, but I don't ever…
they could have given us to play. You never did play down to Dauphine Theater, either, did you?
